names_note: no matrix held; list = the printed tip names of Analysis 1 (genera; the higher-taxon tips Crurotarsi, Ornithischia, Neotheropoda and Neosauropoda as printed; Ohmdenosaurus, Schleitheimia and Tuebingosaurus in bold)
gold_note: Analysis 1 only (the top tree), read by eye at 2x. The three trees overlap on the page (Analysis 2 begins beside Analysis 1's lower half, the pruned tree beside Analysis 2's), so no rectangle holds Analysis 1 alone; the extractor should be judged on the tree whose root is at the top left. Polytomies: Agnosphitys, (Chindesaurus, Neotheropoda) and Sauropodomorpha; Sauropodomorpha (five); Glacialisaurus, Coloradisaurus and Lufengosaurus; Sefapanosaurus, Aardonyx and the rest; and 'Sauropoda' (23 branches). Sauropodomorpha, Massopoda, Sauropodiformes and 'Sauropoda' (printed in quotation marks) label dotted nodes and are kept. Classed slanted in the census; the nodes are rectangular. 67 tips, 5 polytomies (3, 5, 3, 3, 23 children); 4 printed clade names kept as internal node labels. Sample 9 case (census 3, seed 20261272). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
region_note: Analysis 1 lies in this box together with the upper half of Analysis 2 (x < 1100, y > 870), which is not part of the gold tree
